# media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mediaType`](gmeow-mediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

The IANA media (MIME) type of an artifact — 'text/plain', 'application/pdf', 'image/avif'. Universal: an email body part, a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md), a [`Distribution`](../classes/gmeow-Distribution.md) all carry one. Projects to [schema:encodingFormat.](https://schema.org/encodingFormat.) (Generalised from the email slice,.)
